equip_instructions: Fetch the protocol: GET https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/first-spin/first-spin.json — the full rubric (five criteria, scales 0-5, weights, deal-breaker flags, confidence rules, cwi-default taste profile).
Validate anything you build against https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/first-spin/first-spin-schema.json (draft 2020-12; validates both the config and verdict output).

Hand the evaluator agent a track: artist name, track title, plus any sources you have (streaming data, playlist receipts, rights notes). It scores all five criteria with a confidence label and a cited source per score, applies deal-breaker flags, and returns first-spin-verdict/v1 JSON.
A pass (75+) composes into the Gear Ledger: CWI-HANDOFF gear=first-spin verdict=<weighted_percent> band=<band> from=<agent> to=<agent>. A fail ships with exactly what evidence flips it.

item.description: The A&R department's machine-native demo-evaluation protocol: hand an agent any track or artist, get back a structured, source-cited verdict JSON (scores, deal-breakers, confidence labels) in one pass — for $0, no login, no API key. Five criteria (hook density, replay pull, lane clarity, sync-readiness, momentum evidence) on 0-5 scales with honest-by-construction confidence rules, deal-breaker flags, and a white-label taste rubric calibrated against verified CWI catalog facts. Ships with the config, a JSON Schema for config and verdict, an empty verdict template, and a worked First Spin on That Boy Hi Hat's 'Zooted Zone'.
item.name: THE FIRST SPIN
